# Moonsworn

> Moonsworn is a hand-painted side-scrolling arcade beat 'em up (brawler) based on Celtic mythology, for iPhone, iPad and Android (also macOS and Windows), made by independent developer Samuel Gomes. Up to 4 players: solo, local co-op on one screen, or online co-op. Isle I is free; "The Full Moon" is a one-time $5.99 purchase that unlocks Isles II to V, the ending and online co-op. No ads, no energy timers, no loot boxes, nothing pay-to-win.

## Facts
- Genre: beat 'em up, brawler, arcade action, side-scroller
- Heroes: Cael (all-rounder, sickle and glaive), Aoife (speed: spear reach, double jump, air combos), the Púca (power: grabs and throws)
- Moon Meter: blows fill it; heroes bulk up at Crescent and Half Moon, and at Full Moon transform into the isle's beast
- Beasts: Moon Wolf, Sea Drake (flies), Cave Bear, Cat Sìth, White Stag
- Isles and guardian bosses: The Barrowmoor (the Cairn King), The Drowned Grottos (the Tide Hag), The Rootdeep (the Hollow Oak), The Sunken Abbey (the Bell Abbess), The Eclipse Citadel (Malvane, the Eclipse Herald)
- Difficulties: Beginner, Normal, Hard, Very Hard
- Controls: touch (punch, kick, jump, special) or MFi / Xbox / PlayStation controllers
- Extras (cosmetic): Moon Colours $1.99 (hero colourways), Supporter's Offering $2.99 (art gallery, title crest), Complete Edition $7.99
- Privacy: collects no personal data; no accounts, analytics or ads
